execution.outcomeUnknownAlertTitle: High Risk: Unknown outcome; retries prohibited
execution.outcomeUnknownAlertDesc: The target repository transaction may have already been committed. "receipt-v1" must be verified by the system first; only then can "manual-v0" be manually confirmed as applied. Do not re-run this pipeline until the results have converged.
execution.targetSnapshotTitle: Target snapshot for this execution (excluding credentials)
execution.targetSnapshotDesc: The following content is permanently recorded in the execution log and can only be verified against the snapshot from this execution; the current configuration of Data Source must not be used to override historical facts.
execution.targetSnapshotMissing: There are no snapshots of the history; check the runtime logs and configuration backups first. Do not look back at the current Data Source and use it as the configuration for this execution.
execution.targetSnapshotIncomplete: Historical target snapshots are incomplete; for missing fields, first check the runtime logs or configuration backups—do not use the current Data Source configuration to fill in the gaps.
execution.targetSnapshotFieldMissing: Missing (do not autocomplete using the current configuration)
execution.sourceQuerySha256Label: Standardized SHA-256 hash of the source query
execution.verifyTargetReceiptSuccessTitle: Target acknowledgment matched; execution confirmed successful
execution.verifyTargetReceiptFailedTitle: Target receipt verification has not converged
execution.verifyTargetReceiptResponseUnknownDesc: No confirmable match acknowledgment was received; the outcome of the execution remains unknown. Please refresh the page and retry the machine verification; do not manually override the result based on this.
execution.receiptVerificationIneligibleDesc: This receipt-v1 execution lacks complete and stable identity verification; automated verification and manual adjudication have been disabled. Please troubleshoot according to the operations manual and maintain isolation.
execution.resolveWarning: This conclusion will converge the records with unknown results in manual-v0 to their final state and lift the lock. Entries must be based on actual data from the target database and structured evidence references; inferences based solely on error messages are not permitted.
execution.receiptManualOverrideWarning: receipt-v1 only allows the "Not Applied" determination to be made after an exclusive read on the target end confirms that the receipt does not exist. Complete, conflicting, or unreachable receipts will all remain isolated.
execution.resolutionConfirmedApplied: Confirm that changes have been applied
execution.resolutionConfirmedNotApplied: Confirm that no changes have been applied
execution.processedRowsPlaceholder: Please enter the non-negative integer obtained from verifying the target database.

execution.verificationNoteHint: {count} of 141 characters have been entered; only "incident:/change:/work-order:/dba-evidence:" followed by an 8–128-digit security number is accepted.
execution.resolveAppliedSuccessTitle: Confirmed that the target has been written to and applied
execution.resolveNotAppliedSuccessTitle: Confirmed that the target write was not applied
execution.resolveResponseUnknownDesc: Response status unknown; please refresh the execution history to confirm the result. If the result is still unknown, you must resubmit with the same conclusion.

apiReference.designPrinciplesSubtitle: Core principles guiding API development and evolution, helping developers quickly understand and integrate with the SwapMid API.
apiReference.designModuleDescription: Unified API design principles that help developers quickly understand and integrate.
apiReference.autoSyncDescription: The endpoints for each business module on the left are auto-generated from the backend OpenAPI contract (Swagger), refreshed alongside the types whenever a module ships (pnpm sync:api) — no manual upkeep required. For interactive debugging (including auth and live try-it-out), the full Swagger UI is available in development at https://localhost:44362/swagger

principles.urlConventionContent: All custom APIs use the /api/v1/ prefix, with resource names in kebab-case plural form (e.g. /api-groups, /data-sources). Sub-resource actions append a verb suffix (e.g. /set-as-main, /publish, /replay).
principles.paginationContent: List endpoints uniformly use the maxResultCount (max 1000, default 10) and skipCount parameters. The response body format is fixed as '{ items: T[], totalCount: number }'.
principles.timeRangeContent: List endpoints uniformly support startTime, endTime, and timeType. Time values use the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format, parsed as Beijing time (UTC+8); timeType defaults to creationTime and can be set to any time field the resource supports, such as lastModificationTime, startedAt, finishedAt, or deliveredAt.
principles.codeAssociationContent: Create and update endpoints do not require an id in the request body — primary keys are auto-generated by the backend. Resource associations prefer business codes, such as enterpriseCode, departmentCode, or positionCode. Detail, update, and delete endpoints still identify the target resource via the '{id}' path parameter.
principles.errorFormatContent: HTTP status codes follow REST semantics (200/201/204/400/401/403/404/409/500). Error body format: '{ "code": "SwapMid:ENT:001", "message": "Enterprise code already exists", "data": {} }'. Business error codes start with SwapMid:.
principles.httpMethodContent: GET for queries (idempotent), POST for create/trigger, PUT for full updates, PATCH for partial updates, DELETE for deletion. Action-style endpoints (e.g. trigger, publish, replay) prefer POST with a verb path over GET.
principles.authContent: All endpoints require a Bearer '{access_token}' in the Authorization header. For local development, obtain one via the /connect/token password grant; production environments should prefer the authorization_code or client_credentials flow.
